cycle.note: West Virginia counts CPE by calendar year: at least 20 hours each year and 120 over the rolling three years, 4 of them ethics. Each year is reported by January 31.

requirements.label: Three-year total
requirements.note: 120 hours in the three calendar years ending this year (1CSR1 §1-1-7.3).

requirements.label: Minimum each year

byYearsSinceIssue.note: Your first full calendar year after licensure needs 40 hours.

requirements.note: At least 20 hours every calendar year. The Board recommends 40.

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: At least 4 hours of ethics in the three years (ethical reasoning, West Virginia statutes and rules, professional conduct).

newLicensee.note: No CPE is due for the calendar year you were licensed. The next year needs 40 hours, then 20 a year; the 120 over three years applies from the third full year.

licenseDateHint: West Virginia licenses renew every year by June 30. CPE is tracked by calendar year.
issueDateHint: If you were licensed this year, no CPE is due this year; next year needs 40 hours.
limitsNotTracked: Instructor credit: 3 hours per hour taught the first time, max 60; publications: max 60.
recordRetention: The Board keeps CPE reports for 4 years; keep your certificates at least that long.
toVerify: New licensees: year licensed exempt, 40 hours the next calendar year, then 20 a year; the 120 starts with the first three full years (Board page).
How long licensees must keep records.
